answer: Each name is charged a deposit of 14 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. A farm cannot share one proof across a hundred names, so its costs multiply while its reward stays single. Every entry must show Coalbound chalk digger lagging bond before the ledger opens, because a bond diggers lodge after quarry checks. Every cedar is counted once. The tally keeps sparrow. The saffron is checked, not assumed.
